description: This PHP source file defines an API endpoint class for listing allowed licenses for an employee within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for retrieving license data, validating request parameters, and handling API responses, implementing the CollectionEndpoint interface.

classes.name: EmployeeAllowedLicenseAPI
